Recipe tank

One recipe for every tank. Changes below apply to all. Numbers are fleet totals or averages. Check the table for a single tank going wrong.

All tanks

Tap a row to open that tank. Feeding, water care, temperature and sales rules are the same for every tank, change them on any one.

New tank: cycle it first

A new tank has no filter bacteria, so waste has nowhere to go and shrimp added now will mostly die. Add ammonia to feed the bacteria. One group eats ammonia and makes nitrite, a second eats nitrite and makes nitrate. Add more only when ammonia drops near zero, until both bacteria bars reach 100% and ammonia and nitrite read zero. That takes three to four weeks. Too much ammonia burns through KH; when KH hits zero the pH falls and the cycle stalls. A water change fixes it.

    All income and costs

    Advertising

    More reach = more customers for shrimp and kits, if you have stock.

    Breeding laboratory

    Making kits

    Packers and machines turn shrimp into kits. A better packing table or the AI camera makes each packer faster. Staff are paid daily.

    Keep in tanks is shrimp per litre left in your tanks to breed. Packing only takes shrimp above it. About 3 keeps breeding fast.

    Sales staff

    Bulk kit order

    Kits

    Kit = small tank + food + 8 young shrimp. Living kits count toward the goal (+ referrals, influence ✦); dead kits cost influence ✦. Breeders and bought shrimp never packed.

    More numbers

    Quality checks

    Optional. Checks catch sick shrimp before kits ship, so more kits live.

    Projects

    Campaigns ·

    Completed projects

      Shops

      Mall stores: people trust a brand they can walk into. Trust is how well word of mouth works in a region: 60% with none of your stores (85% at home in Abu Dhabi), 100% once one mall in five has your store. Every new region adds to the count. You can close stores, the fit-out is not refunded. Each store is a one-off fit-out, then rent, license and staff every day, and brings its own kit orders and influence ✦. You open one at a time at first, 10 at a time once you run 10, 100 once you run 100. Small shops: more shrimp customers and a few kit orders, trade license AED 12,000/yr, rent paid yearly, each extra of a type costs 15% more.
